# TraceBug

> TraceBug captures a browser bug — session replay, console errors, failed network requests and repro steps — into one offline .html file that AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) read over a local MCP server and fix. Free, open source (MIT), no account, no backend, nothing uploaded.

TraceBug is a Chrome and Firefox extension plus an npm SDK (`tracebug-sdk`). Testers press Capture Bug, reproduce the problem, and export a self-contained report. Developers run `npx -y tracebug mcp` so their agent can read the report with tools such as `get_bug_report`, `get_fix_context` and `get_playwright_test`. The Site Audit checks a page for accessibility, layout, performance, SEO and phone-width problems and exports them the same way.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://tracebug.dev/docs): install the extension or SDK and capture a first bug
- [Site Audit](https://tracebug.dev/docs#audit): score a page for accessibility, layout, phone width, speed and SEO, with fixes your agent applies
- [MCP server](https://tracebug.dev/docs/mcp): connect Claude Code, Cursor or Windsurf to TraceBug reports
- [Claude Code setup](https://tracebug.dev/docs/mcp/claude-code): one-command setup
- [Cursor setup](https://tracebug.dev/docs/mcp/cursor): MCP config for Cursor
- [Windsurf setup](https://tracebug.dev/docs/mcp/windsurf): MCP config for Windsurf
- [AI debugger](https://tracebug.dev/docs/ai-debugger): how the agent investigates a report
- [Playwright reporter](https://tracebug.dev/docs/playwright): failed tests become bug reports
- [HAR export](https://tracebug.dev/docs/har-export): export captured network traffic

## Product
- [Features](https://tracebug.dev/features): everything a report captures
- [Pricing](https://tracebug.dev/pricing): free and open source
- [Proof](https://tracebug.dev/proof): real bugs captured and fixed by an AI agent
- [Claude Code bug reports](https://tracebug.dev/claude-code-bug-reports): hand a captured bug to Claude Code
- [Cursor bug reports](https://tracebug.dev/cursor-bug-reports): hand a captured bug to Cursor
- [Source code](https://github.com/prashantsinghmangat/tracebug-ai): MIT licence
